title: HVAngleEst: A Dataset for End-to-end Automated Hallux Valgus Angle Measurement
text: The open research dataset contains full foot radiographs with foot boxes, great-toe, first-metatarsal and second-metatarsal line annotations, plus HVA and IMA targets. The published data record describes 1,392 images and 1,598 annotated feet.

title: HVAngleEst annotation and angle reconstruction protocol
text: HVA is reconstructed from the acute angle between the annotated great-toe axis and first-metatarsal axis. IMA is reconstructed from the acute angle between the first- and second-metatarsal axes. Normalized endpoints must be converted using the source image width and height before angle calculation.

title: GeoMed locked prediction artifact audit
text: GeoMed Copilot replays a hash-verified three-seed MedImageInsight spatial-line prediction artifact on a locked patient-disjoint unilateral test set. The replay is distinguished explicitly from live encoder inference and from annotation-geometry reconstruction.

title: AASCE MICCAI 2019 Challenge
text: The Accurate Automated Spinal Curvature Estimation challenge evaluates Cobb-angle estimation from anterior-posterior spine radiographs and provides a standardized public research benchmark.
